cases.name: quarantine_regular_file
cases.expected: file stored in quarantine; original path absent; SHA256 unchanged

cases.name: restore_regular_file
cases.expected: original path recreated; SHA256 and POSIX metadata unchanged

cases.name: preserve_acl
cases.expected: ACL identical before quarantine and after restore; SKIP only when tools/ACL unavailable

cases.name: preserve_user_xattr
cases.expected: user xattr identical across quarantine and restore; SKIP only when tools/filesystem unavailable

cases.name: reject_existing_restore_destination
cases.expected: restore fails; existing destination and quarantine payload remain unchanged

cases.name: reject_symlink_source
cases.expected: quarantine fails; symlink target remains unchanged

cases.name: reject_hardlink
cases.expected: quarantine fails when link count is greater than one

cases.name: reject_outside_path
cases.expected: quarantine fails for a path outside the watch root

cases.name: reject_path_traversal
cases.expected: quarantine fails for non-canonical traversal path

cases.name: reject_symlink_quarantine_item
cases.expected: restore fails for a symlink item path

cases.name: jsonl_audit_log
cases.expected: one quarantine and one restore JSON record with matching TEST_ID, path and SHA256

cases.name: wazuh_fim_alert
cases.expected: Manager records at least one matching Agent 001 FIM alert from the watch root; base rule 100030 expected
